title: ledge status
description: A status pill at the start of the bar: a label in a colour that can change on a schedule. Send it to POST /event, or pipe it to `ledge event`.

color.description: A named colour (green, yellow, red, blue or gray; theme-aware) or a #rrggbb hex colour.

id.description: Send an existing id to replace that pill. Give a fixed one (e.g. "aws-auth") so re-sending updates the pill instead of adding another.

url.description: What clicking the label opens. Only http(s) urls become links.

detail.description: Shown when hovering over the pill.

command.description: A bash command to run when the pill is clicked, e.g. a login that re-sends this status. Runs with `bash -lc` in your home directory; its output is appended to commands.log in the state directory. Can't be combined with `url`.

color.description: The colour until the first schedule step (default: gray).

schedule.description: Colour changes. The pill shows the colour of the latest step whose time has passed, and counts down to the last step.

at.description: An ISO 8601 time, or a duration from when it's sent such as "50m" or "8h".

expires.description: When the pill goes away: an ISO 8601 time, or a duration from now such as "8h".

not.description: `url` and `command` can't both be set: a click either opens the url or runs the command
